digest.component_or_area: commit impact analyzer / ticket ID resolver
propositions: referencing_commits performs O(distinct_aliases x store_size) full tracker scans when resolving commit trailers containing ticket aliases, causing 70+ minute hangs on production stores
the resolver should build an alias index once per referencing_commits call and reuse it for all per-commit resolve_ticket_id calls to reduce full scans to a single pass
resolve_ticket_id must accept an optional alias_index parameter that enables in-memory lookup instead of per-call full-store scans
resolve_ticket_id's existing single-call usage patterns must remain unaffected by the alias_index parameter
all ticket ID forms (full, short, alias, Jira, prefix) must resolve identically whether using the indexed or per-call scanning path
